intent.subtype: unsigned mask changes arithmetic right shift
intent.rationale: The unsigned lane mask makes the masked signed error unsigned, so the arithmetic right shift fills with zeros when the retained sign bit is one.

labels.note: Masking signed reverse_error with unsigned b makes the operand unsigned, so >>> becomes a logical shift instead of sign-preserving.
Unsigned b makes the bitwise result unsigned, so the arithmetic right shift zero-fills.
